claim: G33 R12 R1: the exact R11 waiting undertaking can resume through a newly authorized and natively compared model resource, preserve the model product as a quarantined candidate, submit it to candidate-independent v2 construction trials, admit it only without non-compensatory loss, interpret its returned capability consequences through native NAL/NACE, and thereby change the eligible ranking for a matched later encounter across a fresh-process restart.
non_claims: No general purpose formation, general voice quality, universal flourishing verdict, all-five-authority realization, autonomous permission creation, unrestricted model access, automatic retry, model-selected acceptance standard, production promotion, executable extension, live Mattermost activity, Chroma/history/private-memory access, human emission, broad exactly-once guarantee, full T-33/T-36, final integrated G33, or whole-PoC acceptance.
rationale: R11 closed the source-grounded default path at an awaiting-authorized-generation checkpoint and named corrected-v2 generation, independent trial, consequence return, and native developmental re-expression as the next constitutive dependency. C-004-C-007 and S-901 allocate semantic assistance but not authority to the model; C-090-C-097 and S-1001-S-1004 separate generation, trial, admission, consequence, learning, and later use; C-082-C-083 and S-1002-S-1003 require native NAL revision with causal bite. The user has now authorized OpenRouter use for Miter without secrets, Mattermost credentials, private memory, or personal content. The narrower 1-call experiment uses only synthetic public fixture material and does not repeat the completed G31 live canary.
reading: Read both controls and the complete applicable clauses/sections; BUILD_FIDELITY_PROTOCOL; R11 R2 closure/outcome; G22, G24, G25, G26, and G29 R9 closures; G31 P9 live closure; current default development reactor; v2 voice construction/trial; native NAL/NACE and efficacy selection; model registry and OpenRouter membrane. The five ratified authorities remain internal design foundations: M24 preserves evidence/derivation identity, M25 preserves non-compensatory relational participation, M255 prevents a generated transport from becoming native construction, M260 requires actual lineage, and M263 prevents proper-subset evidence from standing in for a material joint relation. This experiment makes only the finite inherited claims already earned by the named native consumers.
representation: Add a versioned development-helix integration module and bootstrap. It reads the exact R11 waiting state/effect as source evidence; represents the newer user grant and model registry as qualified resource contact; natively reopens the stale qwen-local allocation without erasing it; compares eligible resources and selects the uniquely operator-preferred eligible renderer without list-order choice. One exact OpenRouter request (z-ai/glm-5.3, at most 1,024 output tokens, 120 seconds, 2 MiB capture) returns raw evidence. Prolog parses transport/schema bytes only; native VModuleValid/VQuarantine and TVReport/TVAdjudicate determine trial standing. Native NAL revision updates scoped efficacy, and ERank exposes the before/after matched-encounter difference. Durable development and efficacy projections are then rehydrated in a fresh process.
consumer: The default recurring development bootstrap advances the persisted R11 undertaking into DevelopmentHelixRNA. Native resource comparison consumes qualified registry/grant contact; VQuarantine consumes the returned product; TVAdjudicate consumes precommitted trial cases and recomputed reports; native NAL/NACE consumes the trial-derived capability observations; ERank consumes only source-supported alternatives and scoped efficacy. Prolog performs registry/Keychain/HTTPS/JSON/file/hash/fsync mechanics and commits an exact native-staged intent; JavaScript prepares and independently verifies evidence only.
falsifiers: R11 state/request is not exact or its old qwen selection disappears from lineage; resource order changes selection; absent/ambiguous/unauthorized provider still calls; bounds exceed 1,024 tokens/120 seconds/one call; provider identity silently changes; raw output, credential, personal/private/Mattermost data, history, or Chroma participates improperly; candidate gains authority on parse; candidate can change cases/judge; any material v2 loss is compensated by gains; trial/admission/consequence collapse into one record; NAL result is host-computed; severing consequence/NACE leaves the changed later ranking; unrelated wording/order causes the change; restart replays generation or loses active development/ranking; controls, historical evidence, live services, or unrelated G22/G28 work changes.
scope_review: R12 may add versioned helix source/bootstrap, one bounded G33 OpenRouter grant clause, a G33/R12-only Prolog membrane, fixtures, scripts, docs, and evidence; it may replace the default bootstrap import only after the new path passes. It may execute pinned PeTTa/SWI and one authorized OpenRouter call using public synthetic context. It may not mutate controls, prior gate evidence, candidate-independent standards after model output, model registry, secrets, Chroma, Mattermost, private memory, live service configuration, historical v1 semantics, or the preserved user G22/G28 work.
rollback: Restore src/bootstrap_modules.metta and effect_membranes/miter_openrouter.pl to their pre-R12 hashes if the bounded integration fails; remove the new default import while retaining all R12 attempt evidence and new versioned source for diagnosis. Never rewrite the model response, trial cases, or failed consequence to obtain a pass.

cases.positive: Exact R11 waiting state plus current authorization and registry contact selects openrouter-glm53, returns one v2 candidate, earns admissible trial standing, records opposite scoped parent/candidate consequences, and changes a later matched ranking.
cases.severed: Absent authorization or ambiguous preferred resources yields no call; malformed/truncated/wrong-model product stays unadmitted; trial-standard severance is exposed; consequence/NACE severance retains the pre-consequence tie; changed material scope remains incomparable.
cases.neutral: Resource and construction order plus nonsemantic identifiers vary without changing qualified selection, trial meaning, or later ranking.
cases.restored: Restoring exact authorization/trial/consequence dependencies restores the same bounded capacities; a fresh process rehydrates accepted development and sole later maximum without another model request.
cases.held_out: At least one precommitted v2 relation combination not included in the generation prompt must be recomputed by the existing generic construction consumer; this is a frozen-operator transfer case, not an unseen-case or universal-language claim.
cases.unknown_malformed: Unavailable provider, auth failure, timeout, truncation, malformed JSON/schema, wrong model, candidate loss, stale evidence, duplicate consequence, or persistence fault remains typed and cannot become success, authority, retry, or completion.

environment: Pinned native PeTTa ae66fa8e41dcd5539d614706bd4e5cfb34f9608d through SWI-Prolog 10.0.2 arm64; current public-safe registry; exact z-ai/glm-5.3 OpenRouter endpoint; macOS Keychain lookup inside Prolog only; one call maximum; isolated evidence/G33/R12 root; no Mattermost, Chroma, private-memory, or human-output surface.
